claims.evidence: No power-on test or error-code display visible; partial 'Inverter' text on casing is the only supporting detail and only covers the inverter-type claim, not the fault.
No address, landmark, or geotag visible in the photo; location cannot be confirmed from image alone.

risks.risk: Extent of the fault (compressor failure vs minor PCB/sensor issue vs just needs gas)
risks.proof: Video of unit powered on, showing compressor running, fan spinning, and any error code on display/remote

risks.risk: Missing accessories: remote control, mounting bracket, copper interconnect pipes, power cord
risks.proof: Photo showing these items laid out alongside the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as unit-only, buyer bears cost of missing parts

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/BTU and brand/model, affecting resale and installation fit
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/model sticker
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common capacity assumption for this unit size

risks.risk: Internal coil/condenser corrosion or leaks not visible due to dust/grime
risks.proof: Close-up photos of coils after cleaning, or technician inspection report
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming coil service/cleaning or replacement needed

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history, affecting remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Purchase receipt, warranty card, or serial-number date code photo
Technician gauge reading or video of cooling test after power-on

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the unit running, fan movement, and any error code
Close-up clear photo of the nameplate/model/serial sticker
Photo of remote control, mounting bracket, and copper pipes if included
Close-up photos of coils and internals after wiping off dust
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a split AC unit, and the seller's own admission of a fault allows pricing at worst case (non-working, accessories-incomplete) pending the listed proofs to improve the price.
